intro: Romaine is a popular base option on the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases), offering a crisp and refreshing foundation for your custom bowl or pita. At just 20 calories, this chopped romaine hearts option provides a light, nutrient-rich start to any meal. Whether you are building a healthy bowl or exploring the [full CAVA menu](/), romaine delivers fresh flavor without adding extra calories or fat to your order.
priceCalories: Romaine is included at no additional charge as a base option at CAVA, making it an economical choice for health-conscious diners. With only 20 calories per serving, 1g of protein, 4g of carbs, and 0g of fat, romaine provides a guilt-free foundation. This makes it ideal for those watching their calorie intake while still enjoying a satisfying meal from the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator).
whatMakesSpecial: What sets romaine apart is its exceptional freshness and crisp texture that holds up well under toppings and dressings. Made from chopped romaine hearts, the most tender part of the lettuce, this base offers superior taste and crunch. Unlike heavier grain bases, romaine keeps your meal light and refreshing while providing a clean canvas for bold Mediterranean flavors available on the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings).
nutritionFacts: Romaine delivers impressive nutrition with minimal calories. Each serving contains 20 calories, 1g of protein, 4g of carbohydrates, and 0g of fat. This makes it one of the lightest options on the [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases). Romaine is naturally rich in vitamins A and K, plus provides dietary fiber. For those monitoring macros or following specific diets, check the [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) for detailed information.
whatsInside: CAVA Romaine contains just one simple ingredient: chopped romaine hearts. These hearts are the innermost, most tender leaves of romaine lettuce, known for their sweeter taste and crisp texture. With no additives, preservatives, or dressings, you get pure, fresh lettuce. This straightforward ingredient list makes romaine an excellent choice for those seeking clean, whole-food options when building their bowl.
tasteLike: Romaine offers a clean, mildly sweet flavor with a satisfying crunch that refreshes the palate. The chopped romaine hearts provide a tender yet crisp texture that does not overpower other ingredients. Its subtle taste allows the bold flavors from items on the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) and [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) to shine through. The refreshing quality makes every bite feel light and energizing, perfect for Mediterranean-style bowls.
customize: Start with romaine as your base and build your perfect bowl by adding your choice of proteins, dips, and toppings. Layer on grilled chicken, falafel, or lamb meatballs for protein. Add creamy hummus or tzatziki from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads), then pile on fresh toppings. Finish with your favorite dressing to create a personalized, nutritious meal that fits your dietary preferences and taste.
pairsWell: Romaine pairs exceptionally well with grilled chicken, falafel, or spicy lamb meatballs for a protein-rich combination. Add roasted vegetables, tomato-cucumber salad, and pickled onions for Mediterranean flair. Complement with creamy hummus or tzatziki, then drizzle with lemon herb tahini or garlic dressing. For a heartier option, explore [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) combinations that feature romaine as the base for perfectly balanced flavor profiles.
healthyChoice: Romaine stands out as one of the healthiest base options available, with only 20 calories and zero fat per serving. Its high water content helps with hydration while providing essential vitamins and minerals. The fiber content supports digestive health, and the low carbohydrate count makes it suitable for low-carb and keto diets. For those with dietary restrictions, romaine is naturally gluten-free as noted on the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free).
howToOrder: To order romaine at CAVA, start by selecting either a bowl or pita at any [CAVA Locations](/locations). Choose romaine as your base from the available options. Next, select your main protein, add dips and spreads, pile on your favorite toppings, and finish with a dressing. Romaine is included at no extra charge, making it an easy, healthy foundation for endless customization possibilities.
vsAlternatives: Compared to Brown Rice at 310 calories or Saffron Basmati Rice at 290 calories, romaine offers a significantly lighter option at just 20 calories. While Black Lentils provide 270 calories with more protein, romaine keeps meals exceptionally low-calorie. Super Greens at 35 calories is similar but includes arugula and spinach for variety. Romaine provides the crispest texture among greens, making it ideal for those who prefer classic lettuce over mixed greens or grains.
whoShouldTry: Romaine is perfect for health-conscious diners seeking a low-calorie, nutrient-dense meal foundation. Those following keto, low-carb, or weight management plans will appreciate its minimal calorie and carb content. Vegetarians and vegans can easily build plant-based bowls starting with romaine. Anyone who loves fresh, crisp salads or prefers lighter meals over grain-heavy options should make romaine their go-to base choice at CAVA.
worthTrying: Romaine is absolutely worth trying as your base at CAVA, especially if you want a light, refreshing meal that does not compromise on flavor or satisfaction. At zero additional cost and only 20 calories, you can load up on delicious proteins, dips, and toppings without guilt. The crisp texture and clean taste enhance rather than mask other ingredients, creating a perfectly balanced Mediterranean bowl that leaves you energized and satisfied.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Romaine?
faqs.a: CAVA Romaine contains just 20 calories per serving, making it one of the lowest-calorie base options available. It also has 1g of protein, 4g of carbohydrates, and 0g of fat, providing a light and nutritious foundation for your custom bowl or pita.

Yes, CAVA Romaine is naturally gluten-free. Made from simple chopped romaine hearts with no additives or seasonings, it is safe for those with gluten sensitivities or celiac disease. Always verify other ingredients in your bowl meet your dietary requirements.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Romaine?
faqs.a: CAVA Romaine contains only one ingredient: chopped romaine hearts. These are the tender, innermost leaves of romaine lettuce, providing a crisp texture and mild, sweet flavor without any additives, preservatives, or seasonings added.

faqs.q: Does CAVA charge extra for Romaine as a base?
faqs.a: No, romaine is included at no additional charge when selected as your base at CAVA. All base options, including romaine, are part of the standard bowl or pita price, allowing you to choose based on preference rather than cost.

faqs.q: How does Romaine compare to Super Greens at CAVA?
faqs.a: Romaine has 20 calories while Super Greens has 35 calories. Romaine offers a classic crisp lettuce texture with chopped romaine hearts only, while Super Greens combines arugula, spinach, and romaine for a more complex flavor profile with slight peppery notes from the arugula.
